paite: Huan Benjamin gam a Benjamin suan a mi khat mihat leh hangsan mahmah a-om a, amin Kish ahi. Amah Abiel tapa, Zeror tapa, Bekorath tapa, Aphiah tapa ahi.
heading: Saul In Samuel Akimuhpih

paite: Ama'n tapa khat anei a, amin Saul ahi. Tangval deihhuaitak ahi a, Israel mite lak ah amah sang a deihhuaizaw himhim a-om kei. Kuamah aliangzang khup leng a-om kei hi.
Saul pa Kish sabiltungte amang hi. Kish in atapa Saul kiang ah, "Thou inla, sikha khat pi inla sabiltungte va zong dih ve," achi hi.

Huchi in Ephraim tanggam ah avak a, Shalisha gam ah avak hi. Himahleh amu kei uh. Huchi in Shalim gam ah avak ua, huai ah leng amu kei uh. Benjamin mite gam ah avak nawn ua, himahleh amu tuan kei uhi.
Zuph gam atun un Saul in akiang a om asikha kiang ah, "Kisa dih, i pai nawn mai ding, ahuchih keileh ka pa'n sabiltungte awlmoh nawn lou in ei hon ngaihtuah zaw kha ding,” achi hi.

Ama'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, hiai khua ah Pathian mipa a-om a, mizahtakhuaitak ahi. Agen peuhmah ahong tung ngeingei nak hi. Kisa in, huai ah i va hoh ding, i hohna lampi ahon hilhthei zenzen khakleh," achi hi.

Huchi in Saul in asikha kiang ah, "Ahi na a, ngai dih, hoh hita lehang, huai mi a ding in bang i tawi dia? I bawm ah lah tanghou a-om nawn kei. Pathian mipa kipahman tawi ding a-om het kei hi. Bang i nei a eita?" achi hi.
Sikha in Saul adawng nawn a, "Ngai in, dangka shekel mun li a khen mun khat ka tawi lai hi. Hiai i hohna ding a hon hilh man ding in Pathian mipa ka pe ding," achi hi.
Tuma siah Israelte lak a mi'n Pathian dot a-utleh, "Kisa dih, mutheipa kiang ah i hoh ding,” achi nak uh. Tulai a zawlnei achih uh tuma lam a mutheipa achih uh ahi.
Huchi in Saul in asikha kiang ah, "Hoih geih e, va hoh peuhmah ni," achi hi. Huchi in Pathian mipa omna khua ah ahohta uhi.
Mual a kho zotna lampi a apaitouh lai un nungak tui tawi dia hong kuante amu ua, akiang uah, "Hiai ah mutheipa a-om hia?" achi uhi.
Amau adawng ua, "Om mah e, ngai in, na ma uah apai, kin un, tuni in khua ah ana hoh hi. Tuni in mun sang ah mite akithoih uh.

Khua a na luttouhtak un mun sang a an ne dia ahoh ma in na va mu ngal ding uh. Kithoihna vualzawlpa ding ahih ziak in atun mateng mipi'n an ane kei ding uh. Huai khit chiang in amisapte un an ane zel uhi. Huaiziak in hohtou meng unla, na va mu pah ding uh," achi uhi.
Huchi in khua ah ahohtou ua, khua alut uleh, ngai in, Samuel mun sang a hoh ding in amau akituahpih hi.
Saul hong ma ni khat in Samuel kiang ah TOUPA akilak a:

"Zingchiang in hichi hun in Benjamin gam a pan na kiang ah mi khat ka hon hohsak dia, ka mi Israelte tung a heutu ding in thau na nilh ding ahi. Ama'n Philistia mite khut a pan ka mite ahondam ding. Akikou husa uh ka kiang ahong tun tak ziak in ka mite zaw ka limsak ahi," achi hi.
Samuel in Saul amuh in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "En dih, na kiang a ka mi gen; amah mah in ka mite tung ah vai ahawm ding," achi hi.
Huchi in kulh kongpi ah Saul in Samuel ava naih a, "Mutheipa inn koi lai a om ahia, hon hilh dih ve," achi hi.

Samuel in Saul adawng a, "Kei huai mutheipa ka hi. Ka ma ah mun sang lam zuan in pai inla, tuni in ka kiang ah an na ne ding hi. Zingchiang zingsang in ka hon paisak ding. Na lungtang a om tengteng leng ka hon hilh ding.
Ni thum paita a mang na sabiltung thu lunghimoh ke'n. Muh ahita uh. Israelte lunggulh kua tung ah ahia a-om? Nang leh na pa inn a mi tengteng tung ah ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Saul in adawng a, "Israel nam lak a neupen, Benjamin nam ka hi kei maw? Ka inkuan leng Benjamin inkuan tengteng lak a neupen ahi kei maw? Bangchidan a hichidan ka kiang a gen na hia?" achi hi.
Samuel in Saul leh asikha api a, mikhual indan ah apilut a, achialte uh, mi sawmthum lak ah mun zahtakhuai ah atusak hi.
Samuel in anhuanmi kiang ah, "Na kiang a koihtuam ding ka chih, tantuan ka hon piak pen hon la dih," achi hi.

Huchi in anhuanmi in aphei leh atung a om ahon tawi a, Saul ma ah alui hi. Samuel in, "En dih, ka na koihtuam, um inla ne in. Ahun sehsa a dia hiai mite ka chialkhawm lai a ka hon sehsak him ahi, ka na chita ngal a," achi hi. Huchi in huai ni in Saul in Samuel toh ankuang a-umkhawm uhi.
Mun sang a pan khua ahong paisuk un intung ah Saul in Samuel ahoupih hi.
Zingkhangpi in athou a; nisuah kuan in Samuel in intung a om Saul asam hi. "Thou in, ka hon paisakta ding," achi hi. Huchi in anih un apaikhia ua, Saul leh Samuel apawtta uh.
heading: Samuel In Saul Thuhilhna

paite: Khonawl atunsuk un Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Sikhapa i malam ah paisak inla, ama'n hon paipel zoh chiang in, nang bel khawl tadih in, Pathian thu ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
